propositions: Current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy per-type shape (generic H2, char thresholds, bullets) without verifying required sections (Context, Problem, Approach, Scope, Acceptance Criteria) or plan-writing guidance alignment.
Clarity scoring logic is duplicated across two files (gates.py and det_floor.py) creating maintenance drift and inconsistency.

The current measure does not deterministically verify per-AC proof coverage (operator-attested or explicit check clauses) or flag placeholder language (TBD, figure out, depends on investigation) in Scope/Approach.
Required-section structure should vary by graph altitude (leaf vs. container) rather than ticket type, with deterministic detection of nonempty content before next H2 heading.
Author guide and G6 criteria disagree on rejected-alternative requirement; clarity checks currently encode neither, creating inconsistency with active docs.
